== Summary ==
Before/after image for [[Tracked Fleet]]: the PC card image of [[Tracked Fleet]] (8 August 2025, [[:File:V25-D-trackedfleet-2025-08-08.png|V25-D-trackedfleet-2025-08-08.png]], scaled to the slip height) beside the slip of the [https://res.starwarsccg.org/virtual/Set-25.pdf Virtual Set 25 release sheet] (page 3). Made from the two published images (Bill, 12 November 2026).
